title: PQ Adapter Intake Dossier
description: Canonical output of /adapter:intake. It is a strict superset of the two adapter output artifacts: the `registration` block must validate against adapter-registration.schema.json and the optional `access_model` block against access-model.schema.json. The `intake` block is overlay metadata (citations, confidence, vendor terminology, gaps, verdict). Emitting the final YAML files is a pure projection: serialize `registration`/`access_model` to YAML and rematerialize `intake.annotations[path].citation` as `# vendor-docs:` comments. Markdown artifacts and the partner HTML report are all rendered from this single file.

vendor.description: Vendor/manufacturer name as used in the project name

model.description: Product/model name as used in the project name

intake_version.description: Schema/workflow version that produced this dossier

registration.description: Draft adapter-registration.yaml as JSON. Stripped of overlay, this IS the output artifact. May be incomplete while intake is in progress.

access_model.description: Draft access-model.yaml as JSON. Present only when access synchronization is in scope.

doc.description: File name or URL of the source

archetype.description: Recommended implementation archetype, deterministically derived from transport/framing/sample mode.

transport_survey.description: Protocol-side survey of the wire. Each item carries its own confidence and citation; a NO_GO blocker here stops the build.

bridge.description: Vendor terminology mapped to PQ concepts. The de-risking centerpiece: a confirmed vocabulary so the build agent inherits a mapping instead of guessing one.

events.description: Event-mapping worklist. `unmapped`/`needs_new_pq_event` rows are the diagnostic queue: fill semantics, then decide whether PQ has the event or one must be added.

annotations.description: Per-value metadata hung off the registration/access_model blocks, keyed by dotted path. Array items are addressed by type_id in brackets, e.g. 'registration.device_types[GxyPartition].properties.address'. On YAML emit, `citation` becomes a '# vendor-docs:' comment above the value.

gaps.description: Every missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or unmappable area. `classification` separates what the docs answer from what only the user/vendor/hardware can.

vendor_questions.description: Clarifications phrased in vendor terminology, ready to send back to the integrator.

confidence.description: high = cited and unambiguous; medium = cited but needs confirmation; low = inferred, must be confirmed before implementing; none = no evidence

citation.description: Authoritative evidence per _citation-protocol.md. Absence of a citation on a protocol-derived value is itself a gap.

source.description: vendor-docs doc name, or file path for un-indexed source material

gap_ref.description: Id of a gap entry when this item is incomplete

vendor_term.description: The term as it appears in vendor docs

pq_concept.description: PQ concept/type it maps to; null when there is no clean mapping (framework-gap candidate)

maps_to.description: Concrete target: a device_types type_id, a pq.command.*, a pq.event.*, or a function name

code.description: Protocol-native event code, machine-comparable (e.g. '0x8C', '30', 'tns1:Door/State'). Set whenever the protocol defines codes — the event-coverage audit diffs this against the adapter's routing.

candidate_pq_event.description: Best pq.event.* match, or null when none found

status.description: mapped = confident pq.event match; unmapped = no match yet (worklist); needs_new_pq_event = no PQ event exists, propose adding to pq-events.yaml; ignored = intentionally not surfaced (system noise); out_of_scope = excluded by scope

vendor_term.description: Original vendor terminology for this value

id.description: Stable id referenced by survey_item.gap_ref, verdict.blockers, vendor_question.blocks_gap

classification.description: Drives who resolves it. answerable_from_docs means a subagent did not search hard enough and must resolve before bothering the user. needs_framework_decision means the Pq framework itself cannot express what the protocol needs — the vendor cannot fix this; it is resolved by the team at a build CHECKPOINT.

resolution.description: How an answerable_from_docs gap was closed, or how a needs_framework_decision gap was resolved at a CHECKPOINT

attempted_query.description: What was searched (and where) before downgrading an answerable_from_docs gap to needs_vendor

blocks.description: What this gap blocks (capability, type_id, command, or event)

verdict.description: Go/no-go gate. Carries the threshold numbers so the user decides instead of guessing.

decision.description: NO_GO when transport/framing/auth is a blocker or uncited event/command ratio exceeds threshold; GO_WITH_BACKLOG when individual Things/capabilities are missing but core is cited; GO when everything is cited or explicitly out of scope

uncited_event_command_ratio.description: Fraction of event/command codes lacking a citation

transport_blocked.description: True when framing/auth/encryption has a blocker gap

vendor_terms.description: Context phrased in the vendor's own terminology

blocks_gap.description: Gap id this question would resolve
